## Required Deliverable

Using only the allowed inputs, prepare the next shared SCI-MAP v0.1 formal
authority and its scientist-facing and engineering-facing views. The revision
must:

- change only the bounded PTC-handoff and horizontal-ownership delta;
- preserve `SCI-MAP-REQ-001--052` and `SCI-MAP-PRED-001--025`;
- append IDs only for genuinely new obligations and explain each append;
- keep every unrelated owner-ledger question unchanged;
- narrow OD-003, OD-004, and OD-008 only where the admitted owner decisions
  answer part of their existing wording;
- use one canonical shared core for both views; and
- make no implementation, conformity, validation, performance, freeze, or
  readiness claim.

## Firewall

The author must not inspect or receive implementation source, runtime
configuration, audit or review findings, repair directives, tests, reductions,
Unity evidence, achieved performance, production behavior, the internal Stage
A dossier, the full frozen adjacent packages, or later roadmap packages.

The author must not infer a projection class, normalization, boundary-loss
rule, support-threshold domain, publication policy, mode registration, or
common-grid preparation rule from silence.

## Gate

This manifest is inert until the scientific owner approves the exact four
inputs and the bounded deliverable. Dispatch also requires the owner's
explicit approval to use Ultra effort. Approval of this packet does not
approve the resulting scientific contract.
